title: CORAL: Autonomous Multi-Agent Evolution for Open-Ended Discovery

defines.name: CORAL
defines.definition: A framework for autonomous multi-agent evolution on open-ended problems that uses shared persistent memory, asynchronous execution, and heartbeat-based interventions.

problem: Existing LLM-based evolutionary search methods rely on fixed heuristics and rigid control, limiting agent autonomy, knowledge accumulation, and parallel exploration on open-ended problems.
